dataset: Repository starter CSV; 30,000 anonymized content rows x 44 columns; 32 pseudonymous client groups
calendar_window: Calendar dates unavailable; rolling metrics cover trailing 90 days and target compares latest 30 with preceding 30 days
target: trend_direction == down; trailing-window proxy, not future outcome
model: Logistic Regression; numeric median imputation with missingness indicators and scaling; categorical explicit missing value and one-hot encoding; seed 42
week4_rule: log1p(impressions_90d) * min(days_since_last_update,180) / 180; 90-day metric overlaps target windows
